description: This file defines the Mail interface within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It specifies methods related to email properties such as recipients, subject, body, and content type.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Core\Mail\Mail
classes.description: Interface defining methods for email message properties including recipient lists, subject, body, and content type.

methods.name: getToList
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses for the 'To' recipients.

methods.name: getCcList
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses for the 'Cc' recipients or null if not set.

methods.name: getBccList
methods.description: Returns an array of email addresses for the 'Bcc' recipients or null if not set.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject as a string or null if not set.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the email body content as a string or null if not set.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the email (e.g., text/html) as a string or null if not set.
